78	  (1) a manifest field patched post-link via `objcopy --update-section`

123	  registration site live. This is a vendor-toolchain-internals question,
124	  not a vlinux bug - full details and next steps are in the roadmap's U4
125	  DONE note. `test_vlinux_glibc_hello.sh` accepts a clean exit 42 OR this

127	  any other outcome still fails the test.

142	  `__global_pointer$` before running the C handler, so any gp-relative

149	  `stack.c` started building the initial stack AT `mem_size -
150	  STACK_RESERVE` (meant to be the arena's FLOOR) instead of AT `mem_size`
151	  (the true top, with 8 MiB as headroom below) - the build's own content
152	  immediately spilled below the intended floor, so the first big `mmap()`
153	  (malloc's 1 MiB request) zeroed part of the app's own already-live
154	  stack. Fixed by starting the build at `mem_size`.

162	  Two ABI-translation facts, verified against LINUX_TOOLCHAIN's own
163	  sysroot headers (not assumed): (1) the HTIF host's open/openat handlers

165	  bits agree - O_CREAT is 0x40 in Linux vs 0x200 in newlib) - a static
166	  glibc app's flags need translating at the syscall boundary
167	  (`linux_to_newlib_open_flags()`) or O_CREAT silently drops and
168	  `fopen(path,"w")` fails ENOENT. (2) the HTIF host's fstat/fstatat
169	  handlers fill exactly 2 fixed byte offsets (st_mode u32@+4, st_size
170	  u64@+16) in whatever buffer they're given - NOT a whole-struct bounce,
171	  and those offsets match newlib's struct stat (what vplat relies on) but
172	  NOT Linux riscv64's struct stat (mode@+16, size@+48) or struct statx at
173	  all - vlinux must construct the real Linux-shaped struct from those 2
174	  host-given fields, zeroing/reasonable-defaulting the rest.
175	
176	  **Third occurrence of the "fast tolerates it, cycle enforces the real
177	  HW contract" bug class** (see U3's fence.i, U4's gp-reload): the first

180	  requirement (it dereferences a `uint64_t*`); QEMU's byte-addressable
181	  MMIO silently tolerated the misaligned 4-byte read and returned the
182	  right bytes anyway (fast passed outright), but the cycle-accurate
183	  engine's real uncached-device bus logic faulted (mcause=5 load access
184	  fault, mtval pointing exactly at the misaligned window address). Fixed
185	  by loading a whole 8-aligned 24-byte block and extracting fields
186	  locally via little-endian shifts. Worth watching for again: any new
187	  HTIF/DMI-adjacent code that reads/writes sub-8-byte or misaligned
188	  chunks of a window/register interface will pass on fast and fault only
189	  on cycle - always test both legs, never trust fast alone for this class
190	  of code.

---
name: andesim-linux-runtime-roadmap
description: ROADMAP_LINUX_RUNTIME.md is COMPLETE (U0-U9 all DONE, 2026-07-16) - vlinux proxy kernel runs static-glibc llama-completion under andesim fast AND hybrid mode; only optional U10/U11 (Bonsai-27B stretch) remain.

  type: project
  originSessionId: 5eeca9dc-9078-4a2c-9aec-f331d1142619
---

`/home/nick/work/andesim/ROADMAP_LINUX_RUNTIME.md` tracks building `vlinux`
(a new M-mode proxy kernel, `runtime/linux/`, pattern: riscv-pk) so a static
glibc RISC-V binary can run unmodified on all 3 andesim modes (fast/cycle/hybrid),
with hybrid producing a cycle-accurate measurement of ONE kernel iteration.

Primary target as of 2026-07-15: `llama-completion` (llama.cpp's text-gen CLI)
generating text from `Bonsai-4B-Q1_0.gguf` (572 MB, fits the 2 GiB DRAM window
directly). This replaced the original target (`llama-bench` + `Bonsai-27B-Q1_0.gguf`,
3.8 GB) per the user's explicit pivot ("goal revised to run llama-completion
Bonsai-4B model"). See [[llama-cpp-riscv-checkout]] for the supporting
cross-build/model facts this pivot is grounded in.

**Why the pivot**: llama-completion produces visible, checkable generated text
(a real demo) instead of a benchmark table, and Bonsai-4B sidesteps the 2 GiB
DRAM ceiling entirely, so the two features that existed only to work around
that ceiling for 27B (U10: DRAM window >= 6 GB, U11: GGUF layer-slice script)
are no longer on the critical path - they're kept in the roadmap as an
explicitly optional 27B stretch-goal track, not deleted.

## Feature state (one feature per session, per CLAUDE.md)
- U0 (extract `runtime/htif_client.{c,h}` out of `vplat_syscalls.c`, structural
  no-behavior-change refactor so vplat and vlinux share the HTIF window client):
  **DONE** 2026-07-15. All 12 `tests/vplat/*.sh` green before and after.
- U1 (vlinux skeleton: boot, banner, manifest reader): **DONE** 2026-07-15.
  `runtime/linux/{manifest.h,main.c,vlinux.ld,Makefile}` +
  `tests/vlinux/test_vlinux_boot.sh` + `scripts/build_all.sh` `vlinux` target.
  Key design call: no new crt.S - `runtime/crt0.S` (shared with vplat) is
  link-address-agnostic (PC-relative + linker-provided `_stack` symbol), so
  vlinux.ld just retargets it to base 0x0200_0000 with zero new asm. Confirmed
  by research that QEMU's `-bios` (MROM trampoline) and vsim's direct
  `reset_vector` pin both boot from the ELF's own e_entry - no boot stub
  needed. Test runs vlinux.elf as a plain standalone ELF (no --runtime flag
  yet, that's U2).
- U2 (driver `--runtime linux` plumbing): **DONE** 2026-07-15.
  `driver/{manifest.hpp,manifest.cpp,tempdir.hpp,tempdir.cpp}` (new),
  `--runtime` added to `Cli` (cli.hpp/cli.cpp), `run_fast`/`run_standalone`
  wiring in cmd_run.cpp, `tests/andes_sim/test_andes_sim_runtime_linux.sh`,
  docs/USER_GUIDE.md 5.12. `andesim run --mode fast --runtime linux app.elf`
  stages a private `vlinux-run.elf` copy (objcopy --update-section .manifest=
  with app path + mem_size) and boots THAT via -bios instead of the app
  directly. Three scope cuts, each documented in the roadmap's U2 DONE note:
  (1) **fast-only** - cycle/hybrid REJECT `--runtime` with a clear error
  (hybrid wiring is U9; nothing on the critical path before U9 needs it, per
  the roadmap's own Order line); (2) **argv/envp deferred to U3** - `--
  <args...>` parses (matches the roadmap's example invocation) but is
  warned-and-dropped, not forwarded to QEMU's CLI (would be misparsed as
  engine flags) and not yet written into the manifest - no wire format was
  invented without U3's loader to validate it against; (3) **staged
  vlinux-run.elf is not cleaned up** - fast's exec_passthrough execve()s and
  never returns, so the per-run temp workdir leaks (small, few MB, same
  tradeoff class as run_plan.cpp's repro bundles - not pruned, no test
  demands it yet). Also: `--mem-size` defaults to 1G under `--runtime linux`;
  the standalone fast leg's CPU is pinned to `andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512`
  (engine-synced) instead of the ax46 vplat default.
- U3 (ELF loader + Linux initial stack + auxv): **DONE** 2026-07-15.
  `runtime/linux/{loader.h,loader.c,stack.h,stack.c,syscall.c}` (new),
  `runtime/ecall_hook.h` (new, shared) + `runtime/handler.c` extended (a weak
  `handle_ecall` hook - default "unhandled", so vplat's fatal-trap contract
  is untouched; vlinux's syscall.c overrides it), `tests/fixtures/
  rt_linux_argv.c` (new -nostdlib linux-ABI fixture, built with the ordinary
  bare-metal HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN - no glibc needed until U4) +
  `tests/vlinux/test_vlinux_loader.sh` (fast + cycle, same staged
  vlinux-run.elf on both). Scope cuts: no LINUX_TOOLCHAIN yet (U4's job),
  argv stays `[app_path]` only (manifest format unchanged), V-scratch/window
  overlap checks deferred to U9, `_sbrk`'s brk arena not yet app-aware
  (deferred to U4+).

  **Two real bugs worth remembering for any future vlinux/payload work**:
  (1) a manifest field patched post-link via `objcopy --update-section`
  (U2's mechanism) MUST be `const volatile` in C, not plain `const` - at
  -O1 GCC constant-folds a plain-`const` global back to its SOURCE
  initializer, since nothing in the visible program ever writes it (the
  objcopy patch is invisible to the compiler). This will bite again if a
  future manifest field is added without the same qualifier. (2) code
  written into memory via ordinary guest stores (not vsim's privileged ELF-
  load backdoor) needs an explicit `fence.i` before being executed, on any
  cache-modeling engine (the real RTL) - QEMU's cacheless functional model
  silently masks a missing fence.i, so this class of bug ONLY surfaces on
  the cycle leg, never fast. Both bugs were caught by running the SAME test

in `/home/nick/work/llama.cpp`) generating text from `Bonsai-4B-Q1_0.gguf`.

component, pattern: riscv-pk) that loads the app ELF, builds the Linux
initial stack (argc/argv/envp/auxv), and answers the app's `ecall`s by
emulating ~30 Linux syscalls on top of the existing HTIF syscall window.
The hybrid transport, triggers, plugin, resume driver, and engines need
NO changes: the guest stays bare-metal, M-mode, paging-off, single-hart,
exactly the current ROI envelope.

Non-goals (explicitly out of scope here)
- No real Linux kernel boot, no S/U-mode, no paging, no interrupts
  (that is FRS FR-109, a separate track).
- No threads: `clone` returns -ENOSYS; llama.cpp runs with `-t 1`

## U10. Platform track: guest RAM > 2 GiB (full Bonsai-27B) [stretch, off critical path]

Rescoped 2026-07-29 after measuring the real blockers. The original U10 text
said three things that are now wrong or answered:
- (1) "qemu_andesim DRAM window (currently Cannot model more than 2GB)" is
  **DONE upstream**. `hw/riscv/andes_ae350.c:73,131,132` now defines
  `DRAM` 0x0 +2 GiB, `DRAM_ALIAS` 0x8_00000000 +2 GiB (aliases DRAM), and
  `DRAM_EXT` 0x8_80000000 +14 GiB; the error at :1814-1823 reads "Cannot
  model more than 16GB RAM". :974-981 auto-enables the alias when
  `ram_size > DRAM.size` precisely so ext RAM is reachable **contiguously
  from 0x8_00000000**, and :1837-1850 maps ONE `machine->ram` backend across
  both windows via aliases -- so hybrid's `memory-backend-file` already
  spans them. Nothing to do in QEMU.
- (2) "is the vsim testbench memory parameterizable?" -> **yes, in hybrid
  mode it already is.** `vsim_andesim/src/main.cpp:458-465`: when
  `--shared-mem-path` is given, the RAM region is exactly
  `{shared_mem_base, shared_mem_base + shared_mem_size - 1}` with no
  hardcoded 2 GiB. `SimpleMemory<BusWidth>` (src/platform/simple_memory.hpp:14-18)
  takes 32 = bus width in BYTES, not address bits; addresses are u64
  throughout. So the vsim side likely needs NO code change -- U10a verifies.
- (3) "the vlinux arena bounds (already mem_size-driven)" is **the actual
  bug, not a non-issue.** mem_size-driven means mem_size is used as an
  ABSOLUTE ADDRESS, which is only correct while RAM base == 0.

MEASURED 2026-07-29 (`--mode fast --runtime linux --mem-size 3G`, Bonsai-8B):
the guest dies **before the app's first instruction** -- no `llama backend
init`, not even the startup `vlinux: ENOSYS 258/435/220`. One complete
`mcause=0x2 mepc=0x0 mtval=0x0`, then 1,196,874 truncated `mcause=0x`
fragments (11 MB) because the trap handler re-faults on the same broken
stack. Cause: stack.c puts the initial stack at `mem_size - 8 MiB` =
0xBF80_0000, which is unmapped hole in AE350 (RAM ends at 0x7FFF_FFFF, ext
starts at 0x8_80000000). QEMU swallows the stores, the first return reads
back 0, the hart jumps to 0. So today's fast-mode behaviour for >2 GiB is a
CPU-burning trap storm, not an error -- see U10b.

Target: `--mem-size 6G` in both fast and hybrid, Bonsai-27B-Q1_0 (3.8 GB)
resident with NO `--no-mmap` and no layer slicing (obsoletes U11's need).
8 GiB is enough for 27B; the ceiling the map allows is 16 GiB.

### U10a. Probe: does the RTL decode 0x8_00000000? [DONE 2026-07-29 -- answer: NO]

- Description: throwaway investigation, NOT code -- one command, read the
  answer, write it down here. (Avoid the word "spike" for this in a RISC-V
  repo: it reads as the Spike ISA simulator, which is not involved.)
- RESULT: **the high window is NOT reachable on any engine we use.** Two
  layers disagree and only one of them is the truth:
  - `--print-memmap` HAPPILY accepts any base/size, which is MISLEADING --
    it dumps the SystemC/TLM `interconnect` region table, a C++ map, not an
    RTL capability. Measured: `--shared-mem-base 0x800000000
    --shared-mem-size 4G` -> `main_memory.tsck: [0x800000000-0x8ffffffff]`;
    at 16G -> `[0x800000000-0xbffffffff]`. Both "pass". Do not trust this
    output alone for an addressability question.
  - The engine config tells the truth:
    `vsim_andesim/data/configs/ax46mpv_fpga_l3.cfg:291
    set o(NDS_BIU_ADDR_WIDTH) {32}` (and :295 `NDS_L3C_ADDR_WIDTH {32}`).
    The core's bus interface drives 32-bit physical addresses, so
    0x8_00000000 (36 bits) can never be issued no matter what the TLM map
    says. `SimpleMemory::base_for()` subtracts the region base to index the
    mmap, so a 32-bit address against a 0x8_00000000 region matches nothing.
- It IS a per-elaboration knob, not an architectural limit: same repo,
  `ax45mp.cfg` = 38, `ax65.cfg` / `ax66_makatau.cfg` / `ax66_mp2.cfg` = 39.
  Every ax45mpv_premium* and ax46mpv* variant we have is 32.
- Second ceiling, independent of the BIU: even using the full 32-bit space,
  the vsim platform puts HVM at 0x9000_0000, slv_bridge at 0xa000_0000,
  PLDM at 0xe680_0000, smu/uart at 0xf01-0xf03. RAM can therefore only grow
  from 0x8000_0000 to 0x8fff_ffff = **+256 MiB (2.25 GiB total)** before
  colliding. Enough to make 8B work WITH mmap (it missed by ~1 MiB: 1099
  mapping + 931 repack + ~10 app + 8 stack reserve vs a 2047 MiB cap), never
  enough for 27B.
- CONSEQUENCE: U10d/U10e as originally written (rebase guest RAM to
  0x8_00000000) are DEAD for hybrid. U10 splits into two tracks with very
  different costs -- see U10-FAST and U10-HYBRID below.
- Key files: vsim_andesim/src/main.cpp, data/configs/*.cfg (read only)
- State: DONE

### U10b. Fix the missing fast-mode --mem-size guard [independent bug]

- Description: standalone bug, valuable even if U10 never lands. The hybrid
  path caps `--mem-size` at `driver/cmd_run.cpp:514`; the fast path
  (cmd_run.cpp:246-252, `qemu_m_args`) only validates whole-MiB and has NO
  ceiling, which is how the 3G trap storm above got as far as booting. Add
  the same ceiling to the fast path, worded for whatever the runtime can
  actually address (2 GiB before U10c-U10e, DRAM+DRAM_EXT after).
- Input/Output: RED = a run_test/cli-level case asserting `--mode fast
  --runtime linux --mem-size 3G` fails with a clear message; GREEN = it does,
  and no QEMU is spawned. Today that test fails by spawning and trap-storming.
- Key files: driver/cmd_run.cpp, driver/run_test.cpp
- Depends on: nothing (parallel with U10a).
- **State: DONE 2026-08-04.** Pure helper `fast_linux_mem_error()` in
  shm.hpp/shm.cpp + a guard in cmd_run.cpp's fast path, placed before any
  staging or spawn. Unit test lives in infra_test.cpp next to its siblings
  (parse_size/qemu_m_args/max_program_mem_bytes), not run_test.cpp: 2G,
  2097148K, 1G and empty pass; 3G returns a message naming the flag, the 2G
  cap and the runtime; malformed specs stay qemu_m_args's error. RED was the
  compile failure on the missing helper. CLI confirmed: `--mode fast
  --runtime linux --mem-size 3G` now fails instantly, no QEMU spawned. The
  ceiling text says "today": U10e raises it to DRAM+DRAM_EXT.

### U10c. Tidy First: make vlinux's guest-RAM address math host-testable

- Description: STRUCTURAL ONLY, no behaviour change. There is currently NO
  host-side test covering runtime/linux's arena math (`grep mm_init|
  build_initial_stack|load_elf` over driver/ and tests/ hits only the
  driver's manifest builder). Extract the four places that turn a size into
  an address into small pure functions in one header, and unit-test them on
  the host: mm.c:38 `g_mmap_top = mem_size - VLINUX_STACK_RESERVE`;
  stack.c:79 `w.p = (char*)(uintptr_t) mem_size`; loader.c:41-42
  `scratch_base = mem_size - HYBRID_V_SCRATCH_BYTES` + its overlap check;
  and mm.h:10's stated contract. Prove the extraction is behaviour-preserving
  by running the U8 4B smoke before and after.
- Input/Output: new `driver/vlinux_mem_test.cpp` (or runtime/linux/*_test.cpp
  wired like driver/CMakeLists.txt:53) that pins today's ram_base==0 answers;
  all existing driver tests still green; 4B fast-mode smoke unchanged.
- Key files: runtime/linux/mm.c, mm.h, stack.c, stack.h, loader.c, loader.h,
  driver/CMakeLists.txt
- Depends on: nothing (can start before U10a resolves).
- **State: DONE 2026-07-29.** New header `runtime/linux/vlinux_mem.h` with
  three pure functions: `vlinux_ram_top(ram_base, mem_size)`,
  `vlinux_mmap_arena_top` (ram_top - VLINUX_STACK_RESERVE),
  `vlinux_v_scratch_base` (ram_top - HYBRID_V_SCRATCH_BYTES). All three call
  sites now go through them (mm.c:38, stack.c:79, loader.c:41-42).
  `VLINUX_STACK_RESERVE` MOVED here from stack.h -- that header's own comment
  warned mm.c and stack.c "MUST share this one constant or they
  desynchronize", and now they structurally cannot diverge; stack.h includes
  vlinux_mem.h so existing users are unaffected.
  Test `driver/vlinux_mem_test.cpp` (14th driver test, wired in
  driver/CMakeLists.txt) pins ram_base==0 to today's answers AND encodes the
  2026-07-29 bug as an assertion:
  `vlinux_mmap_arena_top(0, 3G) == 0xBF800000` (the unmapped hole) vs
  `vlinux_mmap_arena_top(0x800000000, 3G) == 0x8BF800000`. RED was confirmed
  first (`vlinux_mem.h: No such file or directory`). Also added vlinux_mem.h
  to runtime/linux/Makefile's HDRS so edits trigger a rebuild.

### U10d. Manifest v3: carry ram_base, vlinux computes ram_base + mem_size

- Description: BEHAVIOURAL. `struct vlinux_manifest` (runtime/linux/manifest.h)
  is version 2 with `magic/version/mem_size/app_path/argv_*`; add
  `uint64_t ram_base` and bump `VLINUX_MANIFEST_VERSION` to 3. Every function
  extracted in U10c takes ram_base and returns `ram_base + mem_size`-relative
  addresses. Land it with the driver still writing ram_base = 0, so behaviour
  is provably identical -- the switch to a non-zero base is U10e. Note the
  app image and vlinux itself do NOT need relinking: they live below
  0x0220_0000 and 0x8_00000000 aliases those same physical bytes, so only the
  mmap arena and the initial stack move. brk stays low (its ceiling is
  `_vlinux_base`, 32 MiB), which is fine -- the arenas never need to adjoin.
- Input/Output: RED = a test asserting the arena top for
  (ram_base=0x800000000, mem_size=4G) is 0x8_FF80_0000; manifest_test.cpp
  pins version 3 + the new field; 4B smoke byte-identical output.
- Key files: runtime/linux/manifest.h, mm.c, stack.c, loader.c,
  driver/manifest.cpp, driver/manifest_test.cpp
- Depends on: U10c.
- **State: DONE 2026-07-29.** `struct vlinux_manifest` gained
  `uint64_t ram_base` (APPENDED, so `VLINUX_MANIFEST_VERSION` 2 -> 3: a v2
  reader would mis-parse). Threaded through three signatures --
  `mm_init(app_image_end, ram_base, mem_size)`,
  `build_initial_stack(app_path, ram_base, mem_size, ...)`,
  `load_elf(path, ram_base, mem_size, out)` -- plus
  `build_manifest_blob(app_path, mem_size, ram_base, extra_argv, err)` and
  `stage_linux_runtime(app_elf, mem_size, ram_base, extra_argv, err)` on the
  driver side. main.c snapshots the field alongside mem_size and passes it on.
  RED confirmed first (`'struct vlinux_manifest' has no member named
  'ram_base'`). **The driver still passes a literal 0** at
  cmd_run.cpp's stage_linux_boot, so the guest layout is byte-for-byte v2's --
  flipping it on is U10e/U10f. 14/14 driver tests green; vlinux.elf and the
  driver both rebuild warning-free.

### U10e. FAST-MODE TRACK: >2 GiB in fast mode [achievable now, no RTL]

- Description: BEHAVIOURAL. **This track is unblocked by U10a's finding**
  because fast mode has NO vsim leg -- QEMU's TCG addresses the full 16 GiB
  map, so `NDS_BIU_ADDR_WIDTH` is irrelevant here. Fast mode already skips the
  hybrid cap (cmd_run.cpp:246-252, which is U10b's bug); once the runtime
  honours ram_base (U10d) the driver can hand fast mode
  `ram_base = 0x8_00000000` and any size up to DRAM + DRAM_EXT = 16 GiB.
  Nothing in shm.cpp / run_plan.hpp / memmap.cpp needs to change -- those are
  the hybrid transport. Scope this to `--mode fast --runtime linux` only and
  keep hybrid at its current ceiling.
- Value: unlocks the whole 27B *correctness* story with no RTL work --
  functional runs, bit-exactness A/Bs, output diffs at full model size. Only
  cycle measurement stays capped. Also obsoletes U11 (layer slicing) for
  everything except hybrid.
- Input/Output: `--mode fast --runtime linux --mem-size 6G` boots and runs;
  U10b's ceiling for fast becomes 16 GiB while hybrid's stays 2 GiB, so the
  two modes now legitimately differ and the error messages must say which.
- Key files: driver/cmd_run.cpp (fast path only), driver/manifest.cpp,
  driver/run_test.cpp
- Depends on: U10c, U10d. NOT on U10a.
- **State: DONE 2026-08-04.** `fast_linux_ram_base(mem_bytes)` in shm.cpp:
  0 at or below 2 GiB (every known-good run stays byte-identical), else
  0x8_00000000. `stage_linux_boot` gained the ram_base parameter; fast passes
  the computed base, hybrid pins 0 until U10f. The U10b ceiling rose to 16 GiB
  with a message naming both windows and hybrid's separate 2G cap
  (infra_test.cpp covers 2G/2097148K/3G/6G/16G pass + 17G reject + the
  0x8_00000000 boundary at 2G+1M). PROOF (U10g(1), 2026-08-04): Bonsai-8B at
  `--mem-size 3G` fast WITHOUT --no-mmap -- the exact run that trap-stormed
  2026-07-29 -- boots, mmap-loads, and prints "The capital of France is
  Paris. Paris is the capital of France", byte-equal to the 2G --no-mmap
  control; exit trap mepc=0x8bffffde2 = high base + 3G, proving the arenas
  really lived in the high window. vlinux.elf itself needed NO rebuild
  (manifest v3 reader landed in U10d).

### U10f. HYBRID TRACK: >2 GiB under vsim [BLOCKED on a re-elaborated engine]

- Description: needs a new engine whose `NDS_BIU_ADDR_WIDTH` (and
  `NDS_L3C_ADDR_WIDTH`) reach >= 36 bits, then the driver changes that were
  originally U10e: (a) `driver/shm.cpp:90-94` `max_program_mem_bytes()` 2 GiB
  -> the new ceiling; (b) `driver/run_plan.hpp:27` `mmap_base = "0x0"` ->
  0x8_00000000 when mem > 2 GiB (already plumbed as the `{mmap_base}`
  placeholder, a one-value change); (c) `driver/memmap.cpp:93` V-scratch gpa
  becomes ram_base + program_bytes. Existing tests PIN the old values and are
  the RED step: `infra_test.cpp:55-60` asserts `max_program_mem_bytes() ==
  2 GiB - scratch`; `plan_test.cpp:95,152,481` assert
  `"--shared-mem-base","0x0"`.
- Engine work: the build flow is `config.yaml` entry -> RTL package + a
  `data/configs/*.cfg` -> config tool -> Verilator (`config.yaml:46-53`:
  ax46mpv_fpga_l3 = package `ax46mpv_advanced` + its cfg +
  `--threads 8 --unroll-count 256`). Precedent: premium_max was made exactly
  this way (2026-07-23, ELEN/FELEN 64 + PACKED_FP16 + D$ 32K). The config
  step is standalone and cheap to test without Verilator
  (cmake/VerilatorHelpers.cmake:73-87):
  `NDS_HOME=<tree> tclsh <tree>/config_tools/nds-softcore-config --load <cfg> --generate`

- **GATE 1 PASSED 2026-07-29: the config tool accepts a wide BIU.**
  Probed on a throwaway copy of external/ax46mpv_advanced (94 MB) in
  /home/nick/tmp, leaving the real engines untouched; a control run with the
  unmodified cfg passed first, so the environment was known-good.
  `NDS_BIU_ADDR_WIDTH 32 -> 39` + `NDS_L3C_ADDR_WIDTH 32 -> 39` -> exit 0,
  "Finished customizing IP", and config.inc gets
  `NDS_BIU_ADDR_WIDTH 39` / `NDS_L3C_ADDR_WIDTH 39`.
  - Values are NOT free-form. `nds-softcore-config:6435`
    `NDS_L3C_ADDR_WIDTH value {32 37 38 39 52 59 64}` (enum -- 36 is
    REJECTED: "ERROR: 36 is not a valid option value of L3-Cache Address
    Width"), while `:4363-4368` `NDS_BIU_ADDR_WIDTH` is `textinput` 32-64,
    tool default 39. Pick from the L3C enum; 39 matches ax65/ax66 and the
    tool's own default.
  - **The tool auto-widens 6 dependent RAM/tag widths, which VALIDATES
    regenerating over hand-editing.** Full config.inc diff at 32 vs 39, all
    +7: STLB_RAM_DW 60->67, STLB_DATA_RAM_DW 30->37, ICACHE_TAG_RAM_DW
    30->37, DCACHE_TAG_RAM_DW 32->39, CM_SNP_RAM_DW 21->28, L3C_TAG_RAM_DW
    18->25. Hand-patching the two cfg lines (or config.inc directly) would
    leave TLB and cache tags too narrow to hold a full address -- silent
    corruption, not a build error.
- **GATE 2 PASSED 2026-07-29: the widened engine builds AND is timing-neutral.**
  Done in place on `data/configs/ax46mpv_fpga_l3.cfg` (BIU 32->39, L3C 32->39)
  + `./build_vsim.sh`, at the user's direction. The rebuild is incremental --
  only this engine's config changed, so the other 6 are skipped; the previous
  binary was preserved as `build/sim_ax46mpv_fpga_l3.biu32-backup` before
  building, since build_vsim.sh overwrites in place.
  - `build/Vax46mpv_fpga_l3/obj_sc/config.inc` confirms the widened defines
    reached the elaborated RTL: BIU 39, L3C 39, plus the auto-widened
    STLB_RAM_DW 67 / DCACHE_TAG_RAM_DW 39 / L3C_TAG_RAM_DW 25.
  - **TIMING-NEUTRAL, controlled A/B**: same bin-prefetch, 4B K=51 node ->
    BIU=39 engine 1,384,130 cycles, BIU=32 backup engine **1,384,130** --
    bit-identical. (Staged the backup in its own dir and pointed
    `VSIM_BIN_DIR` at it; driver/engine_registry.cpp:186 honours that env.)
    Expected, since tag-RAM width does not change cache sets/ways or TLB
    entry count. So every cycle number measured on the old engine remains
    comparable, and this widening is safe to keep permanently.
  - Byproduct worth keeping: a REBUILD of unchanged llama.cpp source drifts
    ~0.37% (recorded 1,389,236 -> rebuilt 1,384,130). The A/B above isolates
    that to the binary, NOT the engine. Any scaling/A-B claim must use
    binaries from one build session.

     to 0x8_00000000 reaches main_memory. `--print-memmap` CANNOT answer this

     data up there, which requires a non-zero ram_base --

     corrected 2026-07-29; the earlier "depends on an engine rebuild" was

     width errors surfaced in this build, but nothing has driven a wide
     address through the platform yet -- gate 3 is what would expose it.

  instead buys only +256 MiB (see U10a) and is not worth doing.
- Input/Output: a new engine in `config.yaml` whose `--print-memmap` shows
  RAM at 0x8_00000000 AND which actually executes a load/store there;
  `--mode hybrid --mem-size 6G` measures a 27B ROI.
- Key files: vsim_andesim/config.yaml, vsim_andesim/data/configs/*.cfg,
  driver/shm.cpp, driver/run_plan.hpp, driver/memmap.cpp + the test files above
- Depends on: U10c, U10d (gate 3 cannot even be TESTED without ram_base

# HTIF Syscall Window Roadmap: uncached mailbox, coherence by construction

Goal: `demo/syscall` (and all HTIF file io) passes on EVERY vsim engine,
including `vsim:ax66_makatau`, by removing the root cause found on
2026-07-14: the host services syscalls by backdoor-writing the flat RAM
model, which is invisible through a private write-back L2 (ax66's PL2C).
See memory note `ax66-makatau-syscall-bug` for the full evidence chain.

Fix: move the syscall mailbox OUT of cacheable RAM into a scratch window
inside the SimControl device region. Device space is uncached on every
engine (PMA device attribute - empirically proven by UART + doorbell
behavior on all 3 engines), so no cache can ever hold a stale copy, in
either direction. `flush_dcache()` becomes dead code and is deleted.

## The window contract (shared by vsim, QEMU, runtime)

- Region: SimControl `0xe0080000 - 0xe0080fff` (existing 4KB on both hosts).
- Window: offset `0x800..0xfff` (2KB), device-backed storage:
  - `0x800..0x83f`: eight u64 slots - syscall nr/args in, result in slot 0
    (same layout as the old RAM magicmem).
  - `0x840..0xfff`: 1984-byte data area for payload marshaling.
- Doorbell: offset `0x28` (`SYSCALL_GO`), u32/u64 write of any value ->
  host executes the syscall synchronously (b_transport), result visible
  in slot 0 on the very next guest load.
- Buffer-pointer convention: guest passes full guest VAs that point INTO
  the window data area (`0xe0080840+`); `guest_va_to_host()` resolves
  window VAs against the device storage, so all 17 syscall handlers stay
  unchanged.
- Guest access discipline: u64 loads/stores only (sd/ld) - matches the
  device-access sizes every engine already proves out via the 0x10 HTIF
  doorbell.
- Old protocol (RAM pointer via offset 0x10) stays intact for old ELFs.

- Description: pull the syscall-table lookup + execute + writeback out of

  old RAM path and the new window path share one execution core. No
  behavior change; existing unit tests stay green.

兩件事分開回答。

## 1. 為什麼需要 proxy kernel (`vlinux`)

llama.cpp 的 `llama-completion` 是一個 **static glibc 的 Linux 使用者程式**：它會發 `ecall` 做 Linux syscall (`openat`/`mmap`/`brk`/`futex`/`clock_gettime`...)、需要 Linux 的 initial stack (argc/argv/envp/auxv)、需要有人把它的 ELF 載入記憶體。andesim 原本的 guest 是 bare-metal M-mode，沒有 OS，只有 `vplat` runtime (newlib + HTIF)，那只服務「你自己重編的 newlib 程式」，不吃 Linux ABI。

不能直接跑真正的 Linux kernel，因為 hybrid 的交接契約要求 ROI 內是 **M-mode、關 paging、無 trap、單 hart**；S-mode CSR 和 satp/paging 目前不在 state transport 裡 (那是 FRS FR-109 另一條線)。

所以選了 riscv-pk 的路線：`runtime/linux/` 做一個小的 M-mode proxy kernel `vlinux.elf`，負責 (a) 載入 app ELF、(b) 蓋 Linux initial stack、(c) 把約 30 個 Linux syscall 翻譯到既有的 HTIF window。這樣 **QEMU plugin、resume driver、state ABI、engine 全部零改動**，guest 還是原來的 bare-metal 樣子 (`ROADMAP_LINUX_RUNTIME.md:10-16`)。

支援內容 = U0..U9 (全部 DONE)：HTIF client 抽共用 (U0)、vlinux skeleton + manifest (U1)、driver `--runtime linux` (U2)、ELF loader + auxv (U3)、syscall 核心讓 glibc 走到 `main()` (U4)、file I/O (U5)、time (U6)、file-backed mmap (U7)、fast leg 真的跑出文字 (U8)。

hybrid 專屬的 (U9) 有四項：
- vsim 的 `CsrTrigger` 是在自己的 boot ELF 上 **靜態掃 marker**，看不到動態載入的 app。改法在 driver：`driver/elf_syms.cpp` 的 `find_roi_markers()` 找出 marker PC，`--runtime linux` 時把 vsim 那條腿換成既有的 `--hybrid-exit-pc` PC trigger (QEMU 那條腿不受影響，plugin 看的是執行流)。
- 新增 `--step-timeout-ms` (原本寫死 90 秒，真 transformer matmul 在 ~8.6kHz 的 cycle leg 要好幾分鐘)。
- ggml 4 個 illegal-instruction 修正 (ELEN=32 引擎上的 e64/LMUL=8 float)，以及後來用 ELEN=64 的 `ax46mpv_fpga_l3` 就可以跑原生上游程式碼、patch 全部 revert。
- ROI 選點方法 (`docs/llama_roi_howto.md`)：量 one mul_mat node，4B K=51 在 ax45mpv_premium 是 6,528,953 cycles、在 fpga_l3 是 4,476,168 cycles。

## 2. 為了 27B，vsim 改了什麼

27B (3.8 GB) 需要 guest RAM > 2 GiB，卡點是 **RTL 的 BIU 只有 32-bit 實體位址**，不是 QEMU 也不是 TLM map (`--print-memmap` 會照收高位址，那是騙人的，它只印 SystemC region table)。vsim 側剛好兩個改動：

1. **重新 elaborate 引擎，把位址位寬加寬** — `data/configs/ax46mpv_fpga_l3.cfg`：`NDS_BIU_ADDR_WIDTH` 32 -> 39、`NDS_L3C_ADDR_WIDTH` 32 -> 39 (commit `87a0baa`)。必須用 config tool 重生，不能手改：工具會連帶加寬 6 個相依的 RAM/tag 寬度 (STLB_RAM_DW 60->67、DCACHE_TAG_RAM_DW 32->39、L3C_TAG_RAM_DW 18->25 ...)，手改會讓 tag 存不下完整位址、變成無聲毀損。實測 **timing-neutral**：同一個 binary 跑 4B K=51，BIU=39 與 BIU=32 備份引擎都是 1,384,130 cycles，位元相同，所以舊數據仍可比較。
2. **低位 2G alias region** — `src/main.cpp` (commit `e874381`)：當 driver 給 `--shared-mem-base 0x8_00000000` 時，額外映一塊 `{0, min(2G,size)-1}` 指向同一份 mmap。因為 app image 和 vlinux 還是連結在低位址，core 要從低位視窗抓指令；`SimpleMemory` 各自減掉自己的 region base，兩個視窗落在同一個檔案 offset，語意跟 QEMU AE350 的 DRAM/DRAM_ALIAS 一模一樣。沒有這塊，3G 的 hybrid run 會在低位取指上整整卡滿 4 小時 timeout (那就是 RED)。

andesim driver 這邊配合的是 `hybrid_ram_base()`、`max_program_mem_bytes()` 2G -> 16G、`ctx.mmap_base`、V-scratch GPA 跟著 base 走 (U10f)；fast mode 另有 `fast_linux_ram_base()` (U10e) 和之前漏掉的 `--mem-size` 上限檢查 (U10b，之前 3G 會變成 120 萬次 trap 風暴)。

結果 (U10g)：27B 在 6G hybrid 量到 `MUL_MAT #51 blk.6.attn_gate.weight [5120 x 6144]`，四個 build 依序 54,314,202 -> 25,629,722 (repack) -> 16,317,304 (+prefetch) -> 4,578,346 (d4)，共 11.86x。

已知限制 (U10h，使用者決定暫時不修)：多 GB 模型必須加 `--no-mmap`，vlinux 的 mmap 載入在 27B 規模呈超線性變慢 (8G 記憶體夠用也跑 4 小時還在載入，`--no-mmap` 只要 15 分鐘)。

順帶一提，`e874381` 之前還有兩個 vsim 修正也在這條線上，但那是 ax66/引擎本身的問題而非 27B：HTIF syscall mailbox 改成 device 空間的 uncached window (`c90c234`)，以及 `guest_va_to_host()` 對 alias region 的 base 解析 (`5229426`)。

你說得對，commit 只改兩行，這不衝突。

`.cfg` **就是 config tool 的輸入檔**，不是生成檔。所以「改兩行 cfg + 重跑 build」本身就等於「用 config tool 重生」——`build_vsim.sh` 的 CMake 流程會自動做這件事：

`cmake/VerilatorHelpers.cmake:73-87` 那條 custom command 的 `DEPENDS` 就包含 `${_config_src}` (那個 `.cfg`)，一旦 cfg 變了就重跑
```
NDS_HOME=<build tree> tclsh config_tools/nds-softcore-config --load <cfg> --generate
```
產出 `build/Vax46mpv_fpga_l3/obj_sc/config.inc`，接著才 verilate。`config.inc` 在 `/build/` 底下，被 gitignore (repo 裡唯一被追蹤的 `config.inc` 是 `stubs/config.inc`，跟引擎無關)，所以 git diff 當然只看得到兩行。

我上一輪那句「不能手改」講得不精確，正確的意思是：**不要去手改生成物 `config.inc`，也不要以為只有這兩個欄位需要變**。工具在 `--generate` 時會把 6 個相依寬度一起 +7 (STLB_RAM_DW 60->67、STLB_DATA_RAM_DW 30->37、ICACHE_TAG_RAM_DW 30->37、DCACHE_TAG_RAM_DW 32->39、CM_SNP_RAM_DW 21->28、L3C_TAG_RAM_DW 18->25)。那些值在 cfg 裡沒有出現，是工具推導出來的——這正是為什麼「改 cfg 讓工具重生」是對的做法，而「直接在 config.inc 補兩個 define」會留下太窄的 tag/TLB。

另外 cfg 的值不是自由填的：`nds-softcore-config:6435` 把 `NDS_L3C_ADDR_WIDTH` 定義成 enum `{32 37 38 39 52 59 64}`(填 36 會被拒)，`NDS_BIU_ADDR_WIDTH` 是 32-64 的 textinput、工具預設 39。所以選 39。
